name: imports-negative-tests-a5adab46df/invalid-auto-imports-project-e
spec_references: Subset restrictions / Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported
Subset restrictions / Import declarations: ballerina/lang.int lists Signed8, Signed16, Signed32, Unsigned8, Unsigned16, Unsigned32, toHexString, fromString and fromHexString; min is not listed.
Module-level declarations / Class definition: Supports object-field, method-defn and object-type-inclusion members
reason: The negative case tests explicit aliases that collide with auto-import prefixes, including 'error:min where 'error explicitly aliases ballerina/lang.int. Assessing the argument error for that call requires int:min, which is outside the supported langlib member list. This essential unsupported function makes the whole case a feature despite the supported import, function, XML and class syntax.
unsupported_constructs: ballerina/lang.int:min, invoked as 'error:min(n, ns), including its rest-argument validation
test_design_notes: The @error annotations assert rejection of aliased calls/type references; nonexistent members such as decimal:concat and float:Listener are negative name-resolution checks, not independently evidence of unsupported syntax.
Imports occur in one source file and aliased calls also occur in the other source file of the same package.
